firstPaidCallRunbook: Fetch the paid endpoint without X-PAYMENT and read the HTTP 402 quote.
Verify amount, payTo, network, asset, and the buyer spend cap.
Retry the exact same method, URL, body, and content-type with a buyer-owned X-PAYMENT header.
Store x-x402-receipt-id and x-x402-receipt-url with the paid result before installing the MCP config.

firstPurchaseSuccessCriteria.quoteStep: HTTP 402 includes amount, payTo, network, asset, and accepted scheme.
firstPurchaseSuccessCriteria.paymentStep: Retry the exact same request with X-PAYMENT created by the buyer wallet.
firstPurchaseSuccessCriteria.paidStep: HTTP 200 JSON includes the MCP install plan and receipt gate fields.
